messages:
Sofia (AE): Heads-up: Atlas (enterprise) wants a 2-week POC but with strict constraints: EU data residency, optional on-prem sandbox, and an enterprise security checklist. Scope: 3 flows — entity extraction (KVs), meeting-summary, and reply-normalization. Need baseline prompt set + golds, residency/KMS path, and a headline cost by Wed EOD. @Luca @Rae @Hanna
Luca (SE): Copy. Important detail: they want model outputs deterministic-ish for extraction (stable JSON). Suggest we lock deterministic decode settings and provide a fallback rule-based extractor if needed.
Rae (Solutions Eng): For the POC we'll supply: (a) a concise prompt inventory, (b) 120 gold examples per flow, (c) an eval harness that emits per-example metrics and hallucination flags. Planned commands: `./bin/eval --suite atlas_eu_baseline --n 120 --model redwood-hosted-eu` and `./bin/eval --suite atlas_onprem --n 120 --model redwood-local`
Hanna (PM): Proposed success gates: entity extraction exact-match >= 85% (macro), summary chrF >= 0.58, reply-normalization human-agreement >= 82% on 200 blind samples, p95 latency < 700ms EU region, and hallucination rate < 4% on manual audit. Also define go/no-go for Dedicated/On-prem when KMS/CP isolation required.
Luca (SE): Prompt inventory (first pass) — each prompt will include expected output shape and a short eval recipe:
```
1) extraction_v1: "Extract fields and return strict JSON: {customer_name, invoice_date, total_amount, sku_list}. If uncertain use null. Do not add keys."
2) summary_v1: "Produce a concise action-focused meeting summary (max 4 bullets). Prepend 'ACTION:' bullets for tasks."
3) normalize_reply_v1: "Rewrite the agent reply to be formal, concise, and EU-legal-friendly. Keep <150 chars. Preserve essential facts."
4) residency_tag: "Tag response with 'EU' if input contains EU-personal-data; else 'NO_EU'."
```
Luca (SE): We'll also include a small deterministic parsing layer for extraction: regex + heuristic fallback to reduce hallucinated numeric values. Owner: SE.
Rae (Solutions Eng): Eval harness specifics: outputs per-sample {flow, id, pred, gold, latency_ms, tokens_out, hallucination_score}. We'll produce an aggregate report and a sample-level CSV for debugging. Example parse: `jq '.results[] | {flow: .flow, exact: .metrics.exact, halluc: .metrics.halluc_score}' report.json`
Sofia (AE): Usage profile: avg 1.1 r/s, peak 7 r/s, avg 340 tokens/request. Can finance sketch hosted EU vs Dedicated EU delta? They care about commitment/contract language (PO/Invoice).
Hanna (PM): Action items: 1) SE (Luca) to publish prompt JSON + 120 gold examples/flow by tomorrow AM. 2) Solutions Eng (Rae) to drop eval harness + run guide and a sample report. 3) AE (Sofia) to collect any annotated examples Atlas can share and confirm on-prem sandbox window. 4) Security (security-bot) to draft short answers for KMS, audit logs, and data residency.
security-bot: security: KMS options: hosted-managed keys (default), customer-managed keys via KMS in EU (available on Dedicated); audit logs retained 30d for POC by default; on-prem requires contract addendum.
Luca (SE): For on-prem sandbox we can offer a lightweight container image with the eval harness and model weights (quantized) for an air-gapped run — but that's a legal and ops lift. We'll present it as optional escalation: hosted EU baseline -> Dedicated EU -> On-prem sandbox.
Rae (Solutions Eng): Sample prompt formatting we'll commit to JSONL: prompts/atlas_baseline.jsonl with fields {id, flow, prompt, expected_schema, eval_tag}. Also adding instrumentation to capture response.confidence and token_histogram.
Hanna (PM): Timeline: kickoff Mon, baseline artifacts due Tue AM, mid-POC checkpoint day 7, final decision call day 14. We'll add the residency decision at the mid-POC checkpoint.
Sofia (AE): Customer note: legal expects an explicit clause on EU data residency for approach to logs and deletion. I'll get their exact language and paste here.
ops-bot: canary: atlas-eval-harness build 2.3.0 deployed to eu-staging :white_check_mark:
Luca (SE): Evaluation plan detail: 120 golds x 3 flows = 360 examples. We'll also run a small 50-sample blind human audit for hallucination checks. Run command example: `./bin/eval --suite atlas_eu_baseline --n 120 --out report/atlas_eu.json`
Rae (Solutions Eng): If we hit major extraction failures we'll enable the heuristic fallback and re-run; we should track delta in exact-match and latency. We'll include a quick script to diff runs: `scripts/diff_reports.py report1.json report2.json`
security-bot: note: if Atlas requires control-plane isolation, we must escalate to PS and Legal for contract addendum — expect 2-4 week lead.
Hanna (PM): Acceptance checklist I'll post to the POC folder: owners, pass/fail thresholds, sample sets, handoff notes, and escalation path.
Sofia (AE): Great. If SEs can deliver artifacts Tue AM I can share the baseline with Atlas Wed and confirm kickoff. Thanks team.
Luca (SE): Will upload prompts + golds and include a short README with how to run local on-prem eval (docker).
Rae (Solutions Eng): I'll attach a sample aggregated report and a one-page explainer for the customer on what the hallucination_score means.
Sofia (AE): Closing for now — ping here for any blocker.
